headline: Kuantum Papers announces resignation of its Chief Financial Officer
summary: Kuantum Papers Limited has formally notified the stock exchanges about the resignation of its Chief Financial Officer. The company has not yet named a successor or disclosed the specific reasons for the departure in this initial filing. Changes in key managerial personnel like the CFO can create short-term administrative uncertainty for small-cap paper manufacturers. Indian retail shareholders of the company should monitor subsequent filings for transition details and potential impacts on financial reporting.
why_it_matters: CFO exit brings transitional uncertainty for Kuantum shareholders

headline: Vikram Kumar Khaitan resigns as Chief Financial Officer of Kuantum Papers effective October 31, 2026.
summary: Kuantum Papers Limited has announced that Vikram Kumar Khaitan will step down from his position as Chief Financial Officer. His resignation is scheduled to take effect from October 31, 2026. The company has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding this upcoming leadership change. Investors in the small-cap paper manufacturing space should note executive transitions as part of routine governance tracking.
whats_next: Announcement of a successor CFO before October 31, 2026
why_it_matters: Routine management change with limited immediate impact on share price.

headline: Kuantum Papers shares investor presentation
summary: Kuantum Papers Limited has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. Such filings provide details on company performance, operational metrics, and future outlook for shareholders. Retail investors can review the presentation for updates on financial health and strategic direction. The filing ensures routine corporate transparency for listed stakeholders.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update offers minor visibility into company operations.
